bookEarly.title: Book early, pick up off-airport
bookEarly.body: Off-airport depots are 20-40% cheaper. Take a taxi from arrivals — still worth it.

fuel.title: Always take full-to-full fuel
fuel.body: Return with a full tank — "full-to-empty" deals sound cheap but rarely are.

excess.title: Decline excess waiver at the desk
excess.body: Buy third-party excess insurance for ~£3/day instead of £15-25/day at the counter.

under25.title: Under 25? Compare specialist sites
under25.body: Specialist car hire sites often have younger driver surcharges that are 30-50% lower than international chains.
